@common.attachEmailPlaceholder.sameAsSourceJustification: Example email address “you@example.com”: a recognizable placeholder shape whose @-pattern is what hints “email”. Apple keeps example addresses in this Latin form in its Traditional Chinese localizations too, so translating it would make the hint less readable, not more.
